citation.authors: Garnacho-Castaño MV, Palau-Salvà G, Cuenca E, Muñoz-González A, García-Fernández P, del Carmen Lozano-Estevan M, Veiga-Herreros P, Maté-Muñoz JL, Domínguez R
citation.title: Effects of a single dose of beetroot juice on cycling time trial performance at ventilatory thresholds intensity in male triathletes
citation.journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition

population.description: Twelve well-trained male triathletes (national n = 8, international n = 4), age 39.3 +/- 7.5 y (abstract: aged 21-47 yr), BMI 23.4 +/- 2.2, weight 72.8 +/- 6.9 kg, VO2max 54.8 +/- 3.1 mL/kg/min. Inclusion: no cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic, neurological or orthopedic disorders, no drugs, no smoking. Crossover; only the placebo (nitrate-depleted) session is entered.

protocols.name: placebo_vt1_vt2_cycling
protocols.description: Placebo session: 70 mL placebo drink (1 g powdered beetroot juice in 1 L mineral water plus lemon juice; carbohydrate content not printed, so no meal entered) 3 h before the test, no food or fluid but water in those 3 h; subjects rested. Minute 0 here is the start of the constant-load cycling after the 5-min light warm-up (warm-up load self-selected, not printed, left out): 30 min at the VT1 workload (minutes 0 to 30). Food before the visit is not printed beyond the 48 h diet (~60% carbohydrate, 5.5 g/kg) and the 3 h of water only, so no fast is assumed: init norm_center, no prefast_hours, no meal. Duration 45 min: the printed VT1 stage ('30 min') followed without rest by the VT2 stage, a constant workload at the VT2 power (the paper's 'VT2 time trial', ~15 min; the load is fixed from the ramp test, not self-paced). The stage length is each athlete's own time to exhaustion, so the stage end is a group mean: the placebo mean is 14 min 42 s (printed in the Results, Fig. 1d), rounded to 15 whole minutes, so minutes 30 to 45. Activity levels derived from Table 3 'VO2 (%)' placebo rows (percent of VO2max) times the group VO2max 54.8 mL/kg/min (Table 2): VT1 stage 60.5% x 54.8 = 33.154 mL/kg/min, level (33.154 - 3.7)/31.7 = 0.9291; VT2 stage 83.9% x 54.8 = 45.977 mL/kg/min, level (45.977 - 3.7)/31.7 = 1.3337 (placebo Table 3 'VO2 (%)' VT2 cell, 83.9 (8.3)). Level above 1.0: the model extrapolates here.

findings.description: CO2 output during the 30 min VT1 stage (placebo). The paper says only that Table 3 holds the values 'recorded at VT1 and VT2 in the constant load tests' (gas data in 30 s means); it does not say whether this is the stage mean or an end value, entered as the stage mean

findings.description: CO2 output during the VT2 constant-load stage (placebo). As for VT1, Table 3 does not say whether the value is the stage mean or an end value; entered as the stage mean. The window is the group-mean stage (minutes 30 to 45); each athlete's own stage ended at his exhaustion. Level above 1.0: the model extrapolates here
